✅Enhanced Safety Features: Safety is our top priority. The car seat is equipped with heightened and thicken padding to reduce impact during travel, and built-in adjustable safety leashes that ensure your pet's safety without compromising on comfort. ✅Comfortable & Relaxing: We've designed this with your pet's comfort in mind. The bed is padded generously on all sides, providing a soft place for your pet to rest and sleep. The front edge can be unzipped to expand into a larger sleeping area, making it perfect for relaxation after a long day of adventures, both indoors and outdoors.
✅Practical & Portable: The broad, leather-reinforced handle is designed for ease of transport, reducing the strain of carrying, while the side pockets are perfect for storing essentials like toys and snacks. Perfect for small to medium-sized dogs.
✅Elegant Colour Design: Our dog car seat bed comes in a variety of chic, dual-tone colour schemes that integrate seamlessly into any car interior or home decor. Each colour option has been carefully chosen to enhance the aesthetic appeal while maintaining a luxurious look that caters to discerning pet owners who appreciate a touch of class.

SSOOOK Dog Car Seat Size Guide 
At SSOOOK, our products are divided into three categories:

GOODS — items your pet can go inside (car seats, beds, houses, bags, slings) 
WEAR — clothing worn on their body 
GEAR — equipment-style items like harnesses 

For SSOOOK GOODS, including dog car seats, the size guide is: 

S : up to 3kg / 7lbs 
M : up to 6kg / 14lbs 
L : up to 15kg / 33lbs 

All GOODS products are designed based on this standard to create a cozy space where dogs (or cats!) can comfortably relax inside — wherever you are. 

📌 Tip: The perfect size may vary depending on your pet’s body shape and your lifestyle.

✅Practical & Portable: The broad, leather-reinforced handle is designed for ease of transport, reducing the strain of carrying, while the side pockets are perfect for storing essentials like toys and snacks. Perfect for small to medium-sized dogs.
✅Elegant Colour Design: Our dog car seat bed comes in a variety of chic, dual-tone colour schemes that integrate seamlessly into any car interior or home decor. Each colour option has been carefully chosen to enhance the aesthetic appeal while maintaining a luxurious look that caters to discerning pet owners who appreciate a touch of class.
